courseName: AAI Junior Executive (Common Cadre) Mock Test

questions.question: Reasoning Puzzle #131: In a seating alignment of 156 candidates facing North, Priya is ranked 16th from left. Simultaneously, a runner travels 265 km North, turns East 394 km, then South 265 km. What is Priya's rank from right and runner's net displacement?
questions.hint: Rank from right = Total (156) - Left (16) + 1 = 141th. North/South movements cancel, leaving 394 km East.
